title: Epstein's keycard access to Harvard evolutionary dynamics program

tellings.quote: And he was involved in the evolutionary dynamics uh biology sub program at Harvard. He had keycard access to that.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a philosopher, says on Jesse Michels's podcast that in the 2000s Jeffrey Epstein, the wealthy financier, was involved with a biology research group at Harvard University that studied evolutionary dynamics, and even had a keycard to get into it. Jorjani names the scientists Robert Trivers and George Church in connection with the story. He tells it to show how close Epstein got to top science.
